source_note: 有限测度空间上依测度收敛的等价命题
english_source_note: Equivalent Conditions for Convergence in Measure
callout_id: 有限测度空间上依测度收敛的等价命题#1
english_title: Necessary and Sufficient Condition for Convergence in Measure on a Finite Measure Space
statement_en: On a finite measure space, let $X_n$ be a sequence of measurable functions. Then $X_n \xrightarrow{\mu} X$ if and only if for every subsequence $X_{n(m)}$, there exists a further subsequence $X_{n(m_k)}$ that converges to $X$ almost everywhere.
key_techniques: almost everywhere convergence versus convergence in measure
callout_body: 在***有限测度***空间上，函数列$X_n$是一列可测函数，那么$X_n \xrightarrow{\mu}{X}$等价于任意子列$X_{n(m)}$都存在一个子列的之列$X_{n(m_k)}$几乎处处收敛到$X$
